card.name: Start of hemolysis and hematologic words
card.fires_on: The 'hem' or 'em' piece that begins words like hemolytic, hemolysis and hematologic, mostly in all-caps warning text. It fires right before the rest of the word is spelled out.

modes.label: Hemolytic anemia
modes.description: The first piece of 'hemolytic' in adverse-reaction or warning text.

modes.label: Hemolysis and hematologic
modes.description: The opening piece of 'hemolysis' or 'hematologic' in running text or headings.
modes.example: the destruction of red blood cells (<<hem>>olysis), and death.

card.writes: It promotes 'treat' and 'drug' words, which is a weak link to treatment, so the output effect is unclear.
card.plain: It lights up on the first letters of blood-breakdown words like hemolytic and hematologic.
